<title level="1" right="Hazard 4" pfs="">[Spiky Pit Trap](/Hazards.aspx?ID=424)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Mechanical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=105" />
<trait label="Trap" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=158" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rusthenge](/Sources.aspx?ID=215) pg. 49

**Complexity** Simple

</column>

A piece of hide covered with a layer of dirt and gravel is suspended over a 20-foot pit filled with spikes.

---

**Stealth**
DC 18 (trained)

**Disable**
DC 18 [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) (trained) to manually trigger the trap without falling in, or DC 25 Thievery (trained) to secure the hide so the trap doesn't activate

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Pitfall** <actions string="Reaction" /> **Trigger** A creature or other large weight (such as the rushing waters of the [previous trap](/Hazards.aspx?ID=423)) moves onto the gravel-covered hide; **Effect** The triggering creature or object falls in and takes [falling damage](/Rules.aspx?ID=402) (10 bludgeoning damage) and is targeted by a spike's Strike. A falling creature can attempt to [Grab an Edge](/Actions.aspx?ID=95) with a DC 20 Reflex save (this becomes a DC 22 Reflex save if rushing waters are pouring into the pit). **Melee** <actions string="Single Action" /> spike +14, **Damage** 4d8 piercing

---
**Reset**
Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the hide that covers it must be reset manually (a 10-minute activity) for the trap to become hidden again.
